sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is not semantically faithful: approval status and the approvalEvidence class declaration do not establish an approval-evidence artifact whose coverage includes the ship's intendedVoyage, anticipatedCold, anticipatedWind, and applicable immersion condition. Locate the canonical ship-owned relationship/path and any controlled applicability terms needed to express that qualified coverage, then constrain the relationship rather than using presence-only fields.
